question: Do the versioned public-input manifests preserve exact deposited-library identities and the source hashes verified by the completed RNA runs?
decision: Register the two source manifests as scientific configuration and verify their existing GEO/receipt bindings without an infrastructure exception or biological rerun.
strongest_rival: A plausible cache path could be associated with the wrong sample, histology or source byte identity.
discriminator: Exact131 manifest GSM/patient/histology joins to the prior GEO qualification and542 source-file hashes/paths to successful immutable run receipts.
exposure_record: All source identities and completed public cell/spatial outcomes are exposed. This metadata binding check corrects configuration registration only; no new outcome or state model is estimated.
biological_unit: Patient labels retained from the prior GEO qualification; immediate audited units are131 deposited libraries/sections and542 file bindings.
nesting_and_overlap: Libraries and sections remain nested in reported patients and share the existing source lineage. No genotype, exact serial-section identity or independent replication is certified.

methods: Read only existing manifest, GEO and receipt metadata; compare complete rosters, patient/histology labels, basename/GSM paths and hashes, preserving normalized case only for histology strings.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing/duplicate/conflicting identity or source hash stops. No metadata imputation or sample exclusion to make a check pass.

precision_basis: Metadata consistency verification has no inferential sample size, effect margin or power claim.
interpretation_limit: Execution-source consistency only. Reported patient labels and cache provenance do not establish genotype, section equivalence, receptor function or scientific acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop for any conflicting manifest, GEO identity or frozen receipt input hash; preserve original artifacts and gate settings.
